vllm_provenance.scope: dependencies required by operator import; full vLLM serving dependencies not installed

cyclic_rounds: three forward cyclic and three reverse cyclic orders

timing.api: optimization_benchmark.measure CUDA events; three backends in six forward/reverse cyclic rounds; includes public wrapper costs and host gaps
timing.graph: one graph per backend; each graph captures repeated complete forwards and is timed with divisor equal to graph_repeats; capture/setup excluded
timing.flops: 6 * T * topk * H * I per complete forward; reports effective TFLOPS from this count
timing.correctness: all functional/API/graph outputs against full FP32 oracle at relative_rms and normalized_max <= 0.008; cached fused/unfused exact bitwise comparison

scope: fixed-route complete-forward comparison: M4 Python fused, M4 cached fused launcher, and unmodified official vLLM 0.10.0 public API
baseline_policy: vLLM output and route-weight rounding follow the upstream public API; no Python expert-loop performance backend
